frontdoor.board.title: DEPARTURES
frontdoor.card.prompt: E — ask for a travel card
frontdoor.card.got: Travel card: it can be punched at every station
frontdoor.punch.no_card: There's a punch but no card to punch. The attendant at Aton gives them
frontdoor.punch.again: The card already has the «{0}» stamp
frontdoor.punch.done: Click! «{0}»: {1} of {2} stations on the card
frontdoor.shelf.prompt: E — lost and found: take what's there
frontdoor.lost.whose: {0}: they say it's {1}'s. Usually comes through about {2}
frontdoor.usual.no_money: Not enough for the usual: {0} rub.
line.frontdoor.usual_give.1: The usual, here you go. It's hot.
line.frontdoor.usual_give.2: Already pouring, I saw you coming.
line.frontdoor.card_give.1: Here's a card for you. There's a punch at every station, collect all seven.
line.frontdoor.card_give.2: Here's a travel card. Our club's the first stamp, punch it yourself.
line.frontdoor.card_give.3: The card's free, just don't lose it. We've a whole shelf of lost things as it is.
line.frontdoor.shelf_empty.1: Empty for now. Nobody's forgotten a thing, imagine that.
line.frontdoor.shelf_empty.2: Nothing there. Look in tomorrow, someone always leaves something.
line.frontdoor.shelf_take.1: You'll take it to its owner? Thank you.
line.frontdoor.shelf_take.2: I know whose that is. Pass it on, please.
line.frontdoor.shelf_take.3: Take it, take it. It just lies there looking sad.
line.frontdoor.thanks.1: Oh, that's mine! I looked everywhere. Thank you!
line.frontdoor.thanks.2: It turned up! Here, this is for your trouble.
line.frontdoor.thanks.3: Left it at the station? What a head I have. Thank you.
line.frontdoor.thanks.4: Good lad. Take this, don't say no.
line.frontdoor.usual_regular.2: Good morning! Yours is already on.
line.frontdoor.usual_regular.3: With sugar, as always? I remember.
line.frontdoor.barista_regular.2: Hello, my regular. Same as always?
item.travel_card.name: Travel card
item.travel_card.desc: A cardboard cable car card with squares for stamps. The punch at each station cuts its own.
item.lost_umbrella.name: Someone's umbrella
item.lost_umbrella.desc: A dark blue umbrella from the lost and found. Its owner must be getting wet.
item.lost_mitten.name: Someone's mitten
item.lost_mitten.desc: A red knitted mitten from the lost and found. Somewhere a hand is cold.
item.lost_scarf.name: Someone's scarf
item.lost_scarf.desc: A yellow wool scarf from the lost and found, still smelling of someone's perfume.
item.lost_glasses.name: Someone's glasses
item.lost_glasses.desc: Black-rimmed glasses from the lost and found. Their owner must be squinting.
item.lost_keys.name: Someone's keys
item.lost_keys.desc: A bunch of keys on an anchor key ring from the lost and found. Someone can't get home.
item.lost_bear.name: Someone's teddy bear
item.lost_bear.desc: A teddy bear from the lost and found. Somebody misses it very much.
